# 2023 PageRank, weighted, margin capped at 28

Season 2023, weighted mode. Data through week 13 (857 games). Every team starts the preseason with 100 credit points and is tied for first; the pool stays at 100 points per vertex all season, FCS opponents included, so 100 means average. Damping 0.85, tolerance 1e-10, at most 1000 iterations; the final week converged in 68 iterations. Ranks are competition ranks (tied teams share a rank).
